audit.why: Emerald+ 52.89% over 571 games; diff EVEN / 6-10 matches. Early is Tryndamere's, 4-5 is Rumble's Danger Zone window, 6 onward flips back.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart's late rows (Level 3, First item, 2+ items) read Rumble in both layers, contradicting the packet chart, the whys[] text, the spikes[] text and a 52.89% win rate.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Tryndamere/Skill/Skill/Rumble/Tryndamere/Tryndamere/Tryndamere. whys[2] already says 'even skill', whys[5] and whys[6] already say Tryndamere. The side rows were the outliers.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 5 and 6 flipped to Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere in both layers with matching ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places call Rumble's empowered Q 'overheated Flamespitter'. Overheating is the opposite state: at 100% Heat he cannot cast spells at all. The empowered state is Danger Zone at 50% Heat.
audit.why: Junkyard Titan text: 50% Heat = Danger Zone (bonus effects); 100% Heat = Overheating, 'unable to cast'. Also: Flamespitter is a 600-range cone while Spinning Slash reaches 650, so you can E onto him from outside his cone; Electro Harpoon holds 2 charges on a 0.5s cooldown, so expect both harpoons at once.
audit.corrected: Danger Zone is the empowered window; Overheating is the window to commit into. Flamespitter 600 vs Spinning Slash 650.

audit.why: Flamespitter 10/9/8/7/6, Scrap Shield 6, The Equalizer 130/105/80, Undying Rage 120/100/80.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interaction rule claims Scrap Shield creates terrain and that Tryndamere has no dash. Riot's Scrap Shield text is a shield plus a speed burst — no terrain, no knockup — and Spinning Slash is a dash.
audit.why: Derived flags misfired on tooltip parsing; the description governs. The Equalizer does lay a line of flames that slows.
audit.corrected: Only The Equalizer carves the lane, and it slows rather than walls; Spinning Slash needs a target unit, so it cannot cross an empty gap to escape.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Rumble must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online — his Flamespitter poke trades evenly with your Bloodlust sustain. Keep the wave near your side so he walks to you.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Scrap Shield's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker plus crit lifesteal facetanks Flamespitter — force the fight the moment it completes.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Rumble carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: you outscale a squishy Rumble 1v1 and split past his kite — close before the map decides instead of you.

edits.before: Level 4-5 favours Rumble — overheated Q plus W speed and E slow let him zone and chunk you.
edits.after: Level 4-5 favours Rumble — Danger Zone Q plus W speed and both E harpoons let him zone and chunk you.

edits.before: Rumble's spike arrives with Danger Zone heat — overheated Flamespitter (Q) plus Scrap Shield (W) speed and Electro Harpoon (E) slow let him zone you and chunk your approach before your crits ramp.
edits.after: Rumble's spike is Danger Zone at 50% heat — empowered Flamespitter (Q) plus Scrap Shield (W) speed and two Electro Harpoon (E) slows zone your approach; push him to 100% heat and he Overheats and cannot cast.

edits.before: Levels 2-3 even out as he gets heat management online, then at level 4-5 Rumble spikes: overheated Flamespitter, W speed, and E slow let him zone and poke you before you scale.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 even out as heat management comes online, then at 4-5 Rumble spikes: Danger Zone Flamespitter, W speed and E slow zone you — but bait 100% heat and he Overheats, unable to cast.

edits.before: - Rumble Scrap Shield: matchup-defining — Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Flamespitter: 10s at rank 1, 6s maxed — walk the gap, never stand in the cone. - Scrap Shield is only 6s, so heat is the real gate, not the shield. - Undying Rage: 120s at rank 1 — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Rumble's Scrap Shield: Bait it, then commit. When it is down — Crit him down.
edits.after: Flamespitter's cone is 600; your Spinning Slash is 650 — E onto him through it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Its flames slow — cross The Equalizer, never walk along it.

notes: Riot's Scrap Shield description is a shield plus speed burst only; the kit's knockup/terrain flags on it are tooltip-parse misfires and the _missing rule 'terrain-cuts-retreat' inherits that error, plus it claims Tryndamere has no dash when Spinning Slash is one. Both layers of the level chart agreed with each other but disagreed with the packet chart and with their own whys[] text on rows 2, 5 and 6; flipped in matched pairs.
